name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Independent yes/no choices and multi-select lists.

motionProfile.reason: One local opacity entrance, one indicator mark revision and one scoped box/glyph palette; the hit area, size and external labels keep their own owners.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Checkbox owns one opacity entrance on a later-inserted root; a presenting parent, a hidden host or an unusable control keeps native paint.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Checkbox owns the glyph revision on its own indicator: opacity and the authored scale pose, with a check-to-minus replacement in place.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Checkbox owns its background, foreground, border and scoped ring paint; DOM focus, invalid state and an unverified caller palette settle that paint immediately.
